title: Adjacent differential compatibility of normalized column-cone maps
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex, $I$ a bicomplex with complex index $s\in\mathbf Z$ and resolution index $r\in\mathbf N$ [def-sp-double-complex-total], and $a:K[0]\to I$ a bicomplex map, where $K[0]$ concentrates $K^s$ in resolution degree zero. Let $b\in\mathbf Z$, assume $I^{s,\bullet}=0$ and $K^s=0$ for $s<b$, and let $J$ be the identity-mapped, extended-by-zero and flipped bicomplex [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation]. Let $\epsilon:K\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)$ be a chain map, $C=\operatorname{Cone}(\epsilon)$ [lem-pur-quasi-iso-cone-acyclic], and $F$ a decreasing subcomplex filtration of $C$ [def-sp-filtration]. Write $u_t:K^{t+1}\to C^t$ and $v_t:\operatorname{Tot}(J)^t\to C^t$ for the cone inclusions. Assume its degreewise image steps [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients] satisfy $F^qC^t=(\operatorname{im}(u_t)\text{ if }q\le t+1\text{, else }0)+\sum_{s=\max(b,q)}^t\operatorname{im}(J^{t-s,s}\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)^t\xrightarrow{v_t}C^t)$, with empty sum zero. Set $D_p=\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(a^p))$, $G_p=\operatorname{gr}^p_F C$, and let $\pi_{p,t}:(F^pC)^t\to G_p^t$ be the quotient map. A degreewise isomorphism $e:G_p^t\cong D_p^{t-p}$ is called normalized if (1) for every $r\in\mathbf N$ with $r+p=t$ there is a lift $l:I^{p,r}\to(F^pC)^t$ whose composite with the filtration inclusion is the $(r,p)$ diagonal inclusion followed by $v_t$, and whose composite with $\pi_{p,t}$ is the canonical inclusion of $I^{p,r}$ into $D_p^{t-p}$ followed by $e^{-1}$, using the extension identifications on both sides; and (2) when $t+1=p$ there is a lift $l:K^p\to(F^pC)^t$ whose composite with the filtration inclusion is $u_t$ after the index identification, and whose composite with $\pi_{p,t}$ is the canonical inclusion of $K^p$ into $D_p^{-1}$ followed by $e^{-1}$. The lifts are unique by monicity of the filtration inclusion. Assume additionally that $\epsilon^s$ equals $a^{s,0}$ followed by the extension identification and the $(0,s)$ diagonal inclusion. For $p,t,t'\in\mathbf Z$ with $t+1=t'$, and normalized isomorphisms $e:G_p^t\cong D_p^{t-p}$ and $e':G_p^{t'}\cong D_p^{t'-p}$ [lem-sp-cartan-eilenberg-cone-graded-normalized-iso], we have $e^{-1}\,d_{G_p}^{t,t'}=d_{D_p}^{t-p,t'-p}\,(e')^{-1}$. This concerns one adjacent differential and assumes the specified degreewise maps.

proof.text: Precompose with the left and right cone inclusions using Mathlib mappingCone.ext_from. The extended single K source is zero except when m+1=p. In that degree cancel the extension identification. If p<b use K^p=0; otherwise take the two normalization lifts, apply the augmentation-representative calculation, and identify the cone left differential using extendMap_f and extend_single_d. Equal degree identifications agree by equality elimination.

For the right cone inclusion, the extended I term is zero if m-p<0. Otherwise set r=(m-p).toNat, obtain the normalization lifts in resolution degrees r and r+1, and apply the resolution-representative calculation. Cancel the extension identification, rewrite the cone right differential and the extension differential, and use the two normalization equations. The two cone inclusions are jointly epic, completing the equality.

theorem cartanEilenberg_cone_graded_normalized_differential
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vA} A]
    (K : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (a : ((CochainComplex.single₀ A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      K ⟶ I)
    (b : ℤ)
    (hIbelow : ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (I.X s))
    (hKbelow : ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (K.X s))
    (aug : K ⟶ (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).total
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (haug : ∀ n : ℤ, aug.f n = (a.f n).f 0 ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
        (((𝟭 A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X n))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) (i' := 0) rfl).inv ≫
      (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotal
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 n n (zero_add n))
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone aug))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n =
        (if p ≤ n + 1 then imageSubobject
          ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl aug).v (n + 1) n (by omega)) else ⊥) ⊔
        (Finset.Icc (max b p) n).sup (fun s ↦ imageSubobject
          ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotalOrZero
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (n - s) s n ≫
              (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr aug).f n)))
    (p m m' : ℤ) (hmm' : m + 1 = m')
    (e : (F.gradedPiece p).X m ≅ (CochainComplex.mappingCone
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (a.f p) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).X (m - p))
    (e' : (F.gradedPiece p).X m' ≅ (CochainComplex.mappingCone
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (a.f p) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).X (m' - p))
    (he : CartanEilenbergConeGradedNormalized K I a aug F p m e)
    (he' : CartanEilenbergConeGradedNormalized K I a aug F p m' e') :
    e.inv ≫ (F.gradedPiece p).d m m' =
      (CochainComplex.mappingCone
        (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (a.f p) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).d
        (m - p) (m' - p) ≫ e'.inv
